title: Ifeoluwa Ogunbufunmi (strategist) — 'What happens when founders choose not to compromise their mission?'
summary: Ogunbufunmi is a strategist who works with founders and brands. She put a question to Eric from the audience at the Startup Leap Day Zero event, then wrote up what his answer left her thinking about.
blockquote: Last night, I asked Eric Ries how receptive founders and investors have been to his message of building from Day Zero — staying anchored to your mission and remaining incorruptible. His response got me thinking.
attribution_title: The Strategist Behind Founders & Brands That Scale
